scope: Theorem 1.2 (Cylinder amplitude and planar nesting) of the manuscript “Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Cap-selected-amplitudes-and-triangle-chords-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each sufficiently large N, the preceding cylinder sums are finite and AN := lim H→∞ λ−H N GN (H) exists in (0, ∞). Their asymptotics and the planar nesting asymptotic are AN = N1/6+o(1) , Zv(r) = r1/12+o(1) . The bounds are unchanged by a lattice translation of v.
